finding.confidence: High; source plus one actual workerd probe with paired baseline/new-policy phases
finding.title: Separate reservation rule cache entries by policy version
finding.trigger: An operation reaches ready under a passing land rule. Activation changes only that land rule to block while keeping the reservation input bytes unchanged. Recompute and reprepare the same operation.
finding.reason: land_evals is keyed only by op and input digest; kept is returned before policy evaluation or the new still callback. Input/retained bytes omit policy version. Activation updates operation policyVersion, so reservation current-policy checks do not distinguish the cached verdict historical policy. There is no cache invalidation query.
finding.impact: The changed land policy can be bypassed by a previously cached passing reservation result. This behavior was already present at4ec and is not claimed as a newly introduced regression.
finding.fix_sketch: Scope the evaluation cache by policy version (stored key or separately validated body), including the initial read, competing-record branch, write and final read. Do not put a policy field into RuleInput merely for cache bookkeeping.
finding.test_suggestion: One controlled ready operation under block=false, activate block=true with unchanged requirements/input, reprepare, and require failed/no reservation under the new rule; retain digests/evaluation policy names.
finding.observed: Before: op_land_9 ready under act_1_2bf68f19, one reservation evaluation. Activation11 changes only stage-rule.block to true; recomputation12 retains obl_code-review; after reprepare the same op is ready under act_11_d13f4f37, attempts2. Fresh/current input digest equals old cached digest sha256:3fb82281bf6deafe3a43deca97ebbec94af13f3a1824d0e90a38ef4bcbe9ae0b; callcount remains1 and sole cached decision names old policy. reserve succeeds at13; statepublishing with zero pushes.

scope: Exactly one selected runtime cache test, paired old-policy/new-policy phases. No production source edits, installs, broad suite or additional cache scenario.
pre_existing_basis: Same op/digest cache key, initial kept return, no policy-key or activation invalidation in exact4ec source; no4ec runtime rerun claimed.
